The New Zealand Department of Building and Housing issues a report saying that the CTV Building that collapsed during the 2011 Christchurch earthquake killing 115 people did not meet relevant building standards when it was built in 1986.

New Zealand: The Department of Building and Housing issues a report saying that the Canterbury Television (CTV) Building, which collapsed during the 2011 Christchurch earthquake killing 115 people, did not meet relevant building standards when it was built in 1986.
